questions.question_english: 73. Which of the following represents a primary structural challenge facing the Indian agricultural sector today?
options_english: Excess availability of fertile arable land per individual farming household across rural states
Over-supply of formal institutional irrigation facilities across all cultivated agricultural land
High landholding fragmentation resulting in small and marginal farms
Complete structural absence of seasonal price fluctuations in open wholesale food
questions.explanation_english: A major structural challenge in Indian agriculture is landholding fragmentation, driven by generational division of land assets over time. questions.question_english:
1.

Which of the following phenomena best describes a situation where an economy experiences economic growth measured by Gross Domestic Product without a corresponding proportional increase in employment opportunities?
options_english: Structural Unemployment
Jobless Growth
Frictional Unemployment
Stagflation
questions.explanation_english: Jobless growth occurs when an economy experiences expansion in its Gross Domestic Product without a corresponding creation of employment opportunities. This phenomenon often arises from capital-intensive production, technological advancements, or productivity gains that reduce the demand for additional labor. Consequently, economic output increases while overall employment levels remain stagnant or decline, creating challenges for workforce absorption and inclusive socio-economic development across the nation.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। बेरोजगार वृद्धि तब होती है जब एक अर्थव्यवस्था में सकल घरेलू उत्पाद में वृद्धि होती है, लेकिन रोजगार के अवसरों का निर्माण नहीं होता। यह घटना अक्सर पूंजी-गहन उत्पादन, तकनीकी प्रगति, या उत्पादकता में वृद्धि के कारण होती है, जो अतिरिक्त श्रम की मांग को कम कर देती है। परिणामस्वरूप, आर्थिक उत्पादन बढ़ता है जबकि समग्र रोजगार स्तर स्थिर या घटता है, जिससे कार्यबल अवशोषण और समावेशी सामाजिक-आर्थिक विकास के लिए चुनौतियाँ उत्पन्न होती हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Jobless Growth

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Jobless growth occurs when an economy experiences expansion in its Gross Domestic Product without a corresponding creation of employment opportunities.

Nationalizing major foreign e-commerce companies operating in domestic markets
Democratizing e-commerce through an open-network architecture for merchants
